D: With a price on his head, John fights his way from New York to Casablanca and back.
P: Serve the sushi when John walks into Zero's sushi counter.
S: Hand shaped sushi rice topped with salmon or tuna, with pickled ginger and soy
Sushi rice seasoned with vinegar, sugar and salt, shaped into nigiri topped with sliced salmon and tuna, a touch of wasabi under each, pickled ginger and soy on the side.
Green and black olives warmed with preserved lemon, cumin and harissa, flatbread
Green and black olives warmed in olive oil with preserved lemon, cumin, harissa and garlic for 10 minutes, cooled slightly, served with bread.
Library stack za'atar lavash and labneh
the fight in the New York Public Library

Lavash cut into book-sized sheets and baked crisp with za'atar and olive oil, stacked with whipped labneh, chilli oil, cucumber and mint between the layers. Cut 3 lavash breads into rectangles the size of a paperback. Brush with olive oil, sprinkle with 2 tbsp za'atar and sea salt and bake at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp. Beat 300g labneh with lemon zest and a pinch of salt. Thinly slice a Lebanese cucumber. Stack 3 crackers high with labneh, cucumber, mint and a drizzle of chilli oil between each layer.
M: Lamb shoulder braised 3 hours with ras el hanout, dates and preserved lemon, couscous
Lamb shoulder browned, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, cinnamon and saffron, stock, dates and preserved lemon, cooked covered at 160C for 3 hours. Couscous with almonds.
the streets around Zero's sushi counter

Squid scored and dusted in rice flour, Sichuan pepper and salt, flash fried until crisp, then wok-tossed with chilli, garlic and spring onion. Steamed rice. Cook 300g jasmine rice. Cut 800g cleaned squid tubes open, score in a diamond pattern and cut into strips. Toast 1 tsp Sichuan peppercorns, grind with 2 tsp salt and mix with 100g rice flour. Toss the squid in the flour and fry at 190C for 60 seconds in batches. Stir-fry 3 sliced garlic cloves, 2 sliced chillies and 3 spring onions in a hot wok, toss in the squid and serve with rice and lime.
W: Semolina and almond yogurt cake soaked in orange blossom syrup
Semolina, almond meal, yoghurt and sugar baked at 180C for 35 minutes, soaked hot with orange blossom syrup, almonds on top.
K: Green tea steeped with fresh mint and sugar, poured from a height to froth
Gunpowder green tea and a big handful of mint steeped 5 minutes with sugar, poured from a height into little glasses.

note.text: Everything has a price, John. In my house the price is a good meal first, and then we talk about the dogs.

steps.text: Rinse the rice and cook it.
Season with rice vinegar, sugar and salt and cool.
Shape into fingers with a touch of wasabi under each.
Slice the fish and lay on top. Serve with pickled ginger and soy.
Chop the preserved lemon rind and slice the garlic.
Warm the olives in the oil with the lemon, cumin, harissa and garlic.
Cool slightly and serve with flatbreads.
Brown the lamb in batches and soften the onions.
Add the ras el hanout, stock, dates and sliced preserved lemon.
Cover and cook at 160C until the lamb is tender.
Prepare the couscous and toast the almonds.
Serve the tagine over couscous with the almonds.
Mix the semolina, almond meal, yoghurt, part of the sugar and baking powder.
Pour into a lined tin and bake at 180C.
Boil the remaining sugar with the water, then add the orange blossom water.
Pour the hot syrup over the cake and top with flaked almonds.
Put the tea, mint and sugar in a pot and add the boiling water.
Pour from a height into little glasses so it froths.

s.note: Hand shaped sushi rice topped with salmon or tuna, with pickled ginger and soy
s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar and salt. Shape into fingers with a touch of wasabi under each. Top with slices of 150g salmon and 150g tuna. Serve with pickled ginger and soy.

s.note: Green and black olives warmed with preserved lemon, cumin and harissa, flatbread
s.how: Warm 150g green and 150g black olives in 3 tbsp olive oil with chopped preserved lemon rind, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp harissa and a sliced garlic clove for 10 minutes. Cool slightly and serve with flatbreads.

m.note: Lamb shoulder braised 3 hours with ras el hanout, dates and preserved lemon, couscous
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced lamb shoulder. Soften 2 onions, add 2 tbsp ras el hanout and 500ml stock. Add 8 medjool dates and a sliced preserved lemon and cook covered at 160C for 3 hours. Serve over 300g couscous with toasted almonds.

w.note: Semolina and almond yogurt cake soaked in orange blossom syrup
w.how: Mix 200g semolina, 100g almond meal, 250g Greek yoghurt, 200g sugar and 1 tsp baking powder. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes. Pour over hot syrup of 150g sugar, 150ml water and 1 tbsp orange blossom water. Top with flaked almonds.

d.note: Green tea steeped with fresh mint and sugar, poured from a height to froth
d.how: Steep 2 tbsp gunpowder green tea and a big handful of mint in 1L boiling water with 4 tbsp sugar for 5 minutes. Pour from a height into little glasses so it froths.
